title: Noise Rock
tagline: Guitars pushed past tune and into texture and friction.
summary: Noise rock treats volume, distortion and harsh textures as part of the structure rather than as a side effect. It grew from punk and experimental scenes where a band could make a song feel as unstable as its rehearsal room. The genre often emphasizes abrasion, repetition and the emotional charge of a wall of sound.

pillars.name: Sonic Youth
pillars.why: Sonic Youth fused feedback, scratches and melody into a template that still defines the genre.

pillars.name: The Jesus Lizard
pillars.why: The Jesus Lizard made tension and attack feel physical, with rhythm and volume pushed to the edge.

pillars.name: Big Black
pillars.why: Big Black stripped the form to its sharpest, most abrasive edge without losing a clear sense of purpose.
